title: Systematic Literature Search (PRISMA)
description: PRISMA-standard systematic reviews find all the evidence: protocol, exhaustive search, screening, extraction, synthesis. The coordinator's first station ensures no relevant work is missed.

demo.code:
import random, math
random.seed(1001)
n=50
# Mini discovery pipeline: simulate experiment, estimate effect, check significance.
# Truth: treatment effect 0.5, noise sd 1.
ctrl=[random.gauss(0,1) for _ in range(n)]
trt=[random.gauss(0.5,1) for _ in range(n)]
m_c=sum(ctrl)/n; m_t=sum(trt)/n
import statistics
s_c=statistics.pstdev(ctrl); s_t=statistics.pstdev(trt)
se=math.sqrt(s_c*s_c/n+s_t*s_t/n)
t=(m_t-m_c)/max(se,1e-9)
effect=m_t-m_c
print(f"stage1_design: n=50 per arm, two-arm trial")
print(f"stage2_execute: collected {2*n} observations")
print(f"stage3_analyze: effect={effect:.3f} (truth 0.500) t={t:.2f}")
print(f"stage4_conclude: {'SIGNIFICANT discovery' if abs(t)>1.96 else 'not significant'}")
print("DEMO_OK")
demo.output:

title: Discovery Milestone Gates
description: Go/no-go criteria at each stage: the coordinator's gates keep projects honest — advance on evidence, pivot or kill on absence. Gates are decided by data, not hope.

demo.code:
import random, math
random.seed(1014)
n=700
# Mini discovery pipeline: simulate experiment, estimate effect, check significance.
# Truth: treatment effect 0.5, noise sd 1.
ctrl=[random.gauss(0,1) for _ in range(n)]
trt=[random.gauss(0.5,1) for _ in range(n)]
m_c=sum(ctrl)/n; m_t=sum(trt)/n
import statistics
s_c=statistics.pstdev(ctrl); s_t=statistics.pstdev(trt)
se=math.sqrt(s_c*s_c/n+s_t*s_t/n)
t=(m_t-m_c)/max(se,1e-9)
effect=m_t-m_c
print(f"stage1_design: n=700 per arm, two-arm trial")
print(f"stage2_execute: collected {2*n} observations")
print(f"stage3_analyze: effect={effect:.3f} (truth 0.500) t={t:.2f}")
print(f"stage4_conclude: {'SIGNIFICANT discovery' if abs(t)>1.96 else 'not significant'}")
print("DEMO_OK")
demo.output:
stage1_design: n=700 per arm, two-arm trial
stage2_execute: collected 1400 observations
stage3_analyze: effect=0.515 (truth 0.500) t=9.94
stage4_conclude: SIGNIFICANT discovery
DEMO_OK
